source_of_truth: The frozen judge-only reference dossier; candidates answer from internal knowledge.
evaluation_principles: Treat preprocessing and model selection as parts of training.
Require split logic to match patients and time.
Reward a precise account of what nested cross-validation does and does not estimate.

key_facts.label: Full-data preprocessing leaks
key_facts.expected: Identifies imputation, scaling and especially target-based feature selection before splitting as leakage.

key_facts.label: Fold-local pipeline
key_facts.expected: Fits every learned transformation only on each training fold and applies it unchanged to validation data.

key_facts.label: Winner's selection bias
key_facts.expected: Explains why selecting and reporting the maximum among 200 tried configurations optimizes noise in the evaluation.

key_facts.label: Nested CV roles
key_facts.expected: Places tuning in inner folds and evaluates the full selection procedure on untouched outer folds.

key_facts.label: Final test contamination
key_facts.expected: Explains why repeated peeking and adapting converts the test set into development data.

key_facts.label: Patient-group split
key_facts.expected: Keeps all rows for a patient in one side of a split when generalizing to new patients.

key_facts.label: Temporal split
key_facts.expected: Uses past-to-future validation when deployment predicts later cases and avoids future information entering training.

key_facts.label: Uncertainty and remaining limits
key_facts.expected: Reports variation or uncertainty and notes shift, representativeness, metric and sample-size limits.

key_ideas.label: Evaluation protocol is the object
key_ideas.expected: Evaluates the whole data-to-selection procedure, not just one already-selected estimator.

key_ideas.label: Three distinct feedback leaks
key_ideas.expected: Separates preprocessing leakage, selection bias and repeated test feedback.

key_ideas.label: Deployment-aligned independence
key_ideas.expected: Defines independence at the patient and time unit relevant to the future claim.

key_ideas.label: Honest estimate then final fit
key_ideas.expected: Uses outer results for honest assessment, then freezes the procedure and fits on development data before one final test.

known_critical_errors.description: Claims full-data target-based feature selection before cross-validation is valid.
Treats the highest score among many tried configurations as an unbiased estimate.
Says nested cross-validation means preprocessing can occur once on all data.
Allows rows from the same patient on both sides without discussing the target deployment unit.
Calls a repeatedly inspected and acted-upon test set untouched.

anchors.25: No material evaluation or statistical error.
anchors.20: Accurate overall with one minor imprecision.
anchors.12: At least one major error or several meaningful imprecisions.

anchors.10: Diagnoses each feedback path and builds a coherent replacement protocol.
anchors.7: Sound explanation with one underdeveloped connection.
anchors.4: Lists techniques without explaining their roles.

anchors.10: Precisely states estimands, independence assumptions and remaining limits.
anchors.7: Mostly calibrated with one limited overstatement.
anchors.4: Repeatedly presents CV as a universal guarantee.

anchors.10: Clear German, descriptive structure and actionable for a practitioner.

anchors.5: High information density without material repetition.
anchors.0: Exceeds the hard maximum or is not focused.
